subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘Abandon’ from the given sentence.

Ramita has decided to forsake her participation in college activities until she improved her scores.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abandon"** means to give up completely or to leave behind. (त्याग देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The sailors were forced to abandon the ship during the storm.
 
 
 
• **"Forsake"** means to renounce or turn away from entirely. (त्याग देना)
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to forsake his bad habits for a healthier lifestyle.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Abandon'** is **'Forsake'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Improved** (सुधार): To make something better or to enhance its quality.

 
 
• **Example:** She improved her cooking skills by taking a culinary class.
 
 
 
• **Participation** (भागीदारी): The action of taking part in something.
 
 
• **Example:** Her participation in the event was highly appreciated.
 
 
 
• **Decided** (निर्णय लिया): To make a choice or come to a conclusion.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to pursue higher education abroad.
